data.name: Nawab
data.gender_notes: Nawab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nawab is an Arabic title given to a prince or a ruler, symbolizing leadership, wisdom, and nobility. The name Nawab carries the meaning “Prince, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawab usually hope their child will grow to embody prince, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nawab represents a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad, known for his bravery and generosity.
data.etymology: Nawab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prince, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawab total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نواب
in_arabic.meaning: الجاهل أو الحاكم أو الشخص ذو المكانة العالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: نواب هو الشخص الذي يتمتع بالسلطة و الجاه و المكانة العالية في المجتمع، و هو أيضاً الشخص الذي يحكم أو يرأس في منطقة معينة، و يأتي من الجذر العربي ن-و-ب الذي يعني الانتقال إلى مكانة عالية أو الحصول على السلطة.

in_urdu.name: نواب
in_urdu.meaning: حکم کرنے والا، جاہل، ممتاز شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: نواب کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی علاقے پر حکم کرتا ہے یا حکومت کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی جذر ن-و-ب سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اعلیٰ مقام حاصل کرنا یا کسی اعلیٰ مقام پر جانا، نواب نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ نام تاریخ میں نوابوں اور حاکموں کے لئے استعمال ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नवाब
in_hindi.long_meaning: नवाब नाम का अर्थ है शासक या उच्च पदस्थ व्यक्ति, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है उच्च स्थान या पद प्राप्त करना, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि इतिहास में नवाबों और शासकों ने इस नाम का उपयोग किया है।

in_pashto.name: نواب
in_pashto.long_meaning: نواب د دغه نوم معنی دا ده چې کوم شخص د يوې سيمې يا قوم پر مخه حاکم يا مشر وي، دا نوم د عربي ريښو ن-و-ب څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د لوړ مقام يا قدرت ترلاسه کولو مانا لري، په پښتني کلتور کې دا نوم د احترام او لوړ مقام څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Nawab
in_english.meaning: Ruler, Governor, or Person of High Rank
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nawab originates from the Arabic root 'n-w-b' which means to attain a high position or to have power, it refers to a ruler, governor, or a person of high rank and status in society, historically used in Islamic tradition to denote high-ranking officials or nobles, the name signifies leadership, authority, and respect.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Nawab" carries a rich historical and cultural significance in the Islamic world. It originated during the Mughal Empire in India and was often bestowed upon high-ranking officials, military commanders, and provincial governors. The title was a mark of dignity, power, and authority, and was often used in conjunction with the ruler's birth name. The title continues to be used in South Asia, particularly in Pakistan and Bangladesh, as a title of respect and honor.
data.spiritual_significance: The use of the title "Nawab" has spiritual roots as well. In Islamic tradition, a leader is seen as a caretaker and trusted servant of Allah, responsible for the well-being and welfare of his subjects. The title "Nawab" is a reminder of the leader's sacred duty to rule with justice, fairness, and compassion, and to foster peace, unity, and harmony in society. The title is a reminder of the spiritual responsibility that comes with power and authority, and the importance of serving God and His creation with humility, wisdom, and courage.
